title: Treatise on the Cleaving Chain
summary: Links separate cleaving cuts of the battle axe into one flowing chain, adding qi to the later strokes.

title: Handbook of Bearded Hook and Haft Lock
summary: Teaches students to hook a weapon with the axe's beard and lock it against the haft.

title: Drill-Book of Axe-Head Rotation
summary: Trains Warriors to spin the head around the hands for quick changes between bit, beard and poll.

title: Workbook of the Two-Cut Combination
summary: Drills one fixed pair of battle axe cuts until a student can throw them faster than a guard can answer.

title: Canon of Rim, Beard and Bit
summary: Describes the three working parts of a battle axe head and sets out cuts for each, for Warriors with steady qi.

title: Guide to Cutting Through Shield Wood
summary: Shows how to split wooden shields and plank cover with qi-backed axe strokes, for students who carry a war axe.

title: Manual of the Whirling Head
summary: Teaches a Warrior to keep the heavy axe head whirling around the body in wide protective circles.

title: Primer of Heavy-Axe Breath Control
summary: Teaches students to carry the weight of a large axe by timing their breath and qi to each swing.

title: Handbook of the Rank-Breaking Axe
summary: Teaches Warriors to break a line of shielded or armoured foes by hooking, shoving and chopping in turn.

title: Treatise on Counter-Chop and Recovery
summary: Drills the user to answer a strike with a chop in the same breath, then recover the guard.
